models_evaluated: ten LLM platforms (specific names not stated in text)

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of LLM-generated diabetes education texts
links.effect: Readability indices varied by platform (most p<0.001); greater reading burden tended to co-occur with lower GQS, PEMAT-P, and EQIP-36 scores; PEMAT-P actionability differed by topic (p<0.001).
links.quote: Exploratory regression analyses suggested that greater reading burden tended to co-occur with lower GQS, PEMAT-P, and EQIP-36 scores.

unlisted_practices: Structured prompting with templates for patient education generation
Cross-platform selection of LLMs based on quality and readability comparison

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks and compares the quality, readability, and actionability of diabetes education texts generated across 10 LLM platforms without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
